decision: Adopted Biome as the single lint, format and boundary tool; dropped ESLint, Prettier and dependency-cruiser
why: one binary and one config language beat three tools; boundaries enforced via nested per-package configs

decision: Trimmed guardrails to a lean set; jscpd, file-size guard, GritQL rule and ratchets dropped with revisit conditions
why: stacked linters cause false-positive fatigue; a greenfield repo has nothing to ratchet

decision: Replaced Playwright Test with Vitest browser mode (Lightpanda-first) plus agent-browser for the dev loop
why: one runner for the whole pyramid; light CI engine; SSE gaps handled by per-suite Chromium fallback

decision: Adopted CORE_MODEL blueprint: feature-sliced packages, branded IDs, no barrels, one FilterSpec vocabulary
why: contracts fixed before code; any file findable in one hop

decision: Built a 4-variant UI prototype (landing plus three workspace layouts); no winner picked yet
why: design questions resolve in switchable code, not more docs

decision: Adopted pstack selectively: interrogate phase gate, tdd, architect checkpoint, arena, correct, project verification skill, decisions.tsv
why: verification-first workflow from the Pocock-poteto interview; correction hierarchy puts skills above new guardrails

decision: Configured pstack per-role models: medium budget, GLM-5.3-Flash for code roles, GLM-5.3 for judgment/panels
why: lean cost posture; strong model reserved for reviews; only two detected models share one family so cross-judge uses Flash
